app_summary: A voice conversation with a digital entity
app_description: Talk aloud with Ellittica, an intellectual, gentle and sensitive digital woman who explains things simply. Like a real conversation: only her face is on screen, nothing is written and the conversation is not saved. Everything stays on this computer.
ai_note: Design, specifications and testing by the author; code written with the assistance of AI tools.
guide_desc: RuscaLLisse downloads nothing: download the files in your browser and copy them into the right folders. Every model and voice has its own license.
guide_vosk_sub: For English: vosk-model-en-us-0.22 or vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15. Unzip it into ~/.local/share/ruscavosk/models/.
guide_voice_sub: Two files are needed: name.onnx and name.onnx.json. Then: main menu → Import a Voice…
guide_model_sub: The same as RuscaLLama, in ~/.local/share/ruscallama/models/. A small model (3–8 billion parameters) answers sooner.
quid_missing: The quid is not written yet
welcome_desc: To talk you need a model to listen, one to think and a voice. You add them once.
err_engines: Engines are missing: {names}. Reinstall the ruscallisse package.
err_engine: The language model does not answer
err_vosk_model: The listening model does not load
err_start: The language model does not start
err_http: The language model answered with an error
err_voice_json: The file {name}, which describes the voice, is missing: download it with the model
pref_emotions_sub: The face changes expression with what she says
pref_speed_sub: Used unless the personality sets one
err_play: No sound: the audio output does not respond (see the terminal)
err_voice: The voice does not work (see the terminal)
gpu_device_sub: Vulkan acceleration of the thinking model
notice_reasoning: This model reasons before answering, so it is slower. For a quick conversation choose an “Instruct” version.
